{{Lang|Xianfeng|zh=羡风|zh_rm=Xiànfēng}} is an NPC in {{Location|Memento Square}}.

==Location==
Xianfeng can be found in Memento Square after completing the quest [[Utterance of Marvels: II]].

<gallery>
NPC Location Xianfeng.png|Xianfeng's location
NPC Location Xianfeng Context.png|Additional context
</gallery>

==Profile==
Xianfeng is a [[Midnight Rangers|Midnight Ranger]] stationed at Memento Square. His Forte allows him to find "the right launching" point when moving heavy objects. This has become a useful asset during his time on an exploratory mission, as he's used it to help clear roadblocks and rescue trapped citizens.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Xianfeng:''' The rock wall was so loose, I broke the rock off before I could even push it.
:'''Xianfeng:''' It must have been challenging for [[Haobai]] to write this report. I wonder how [[Yirou]] will react to it...
:{{DIcon}} You're very strong.
:'''Xianfeng:''' Haha, it's not just about physical strength.
:'''Xianfeng:''' As long as you find the right launching point, you can do a lot of things that seem impossible.
:'''Xianfeng:''' It's sort of my empathic ability, doesn't that sound a bit common, haha.
:'''Xianfeng:''' The ability can be practical, though. There's been more [[Tacet Field]] around lately, and the [[TD]] is stupidly awesome.
:'''Xianfeng:''' There's a rockslide caused by TD every couple of days. If it happens to block the road, people get stuck in the mountains.
:'''Xianfeng:''' Luckily, I've saved a lot of trapped people with this empathic ability.
:'''Xianfeng:''' If you run into any difficulties, especially if you need to clear a rocky roadblock or something like that, just call me.
{{Dialogue End}}
